mistake_reason: The Assistant accepted the initial pivot summary result (which excluded a valid 2003 Blu-Ray year due to trailing spaces in a string field) and returned "Canyon Shadows" without performing basic validation steps such as trimming and coercing the Release_Year values or re-sorting the filtered Blu-Ray entries. This omission of verification allowed an incorrect outcome to propagate, matching FM-3.2 (No or Incomplete Verification).
